'''NK Mosor''', also known as '''HBDNK "Mosor – Sveti Jure"''', was a [[Croatia]]n [[football (soccer)|football]] club from [[Žrnovnica]], settlement which is part of the city of [[Split, Croatia|Split]] on the Croatian coast.

The club was founded in 1929. It existed until [[World War II]] when most of its members enlisted in the army. When the war ended, the club had experienced such a high rate of fatalities that it was disbanded. In 1964 a team was once again formed. Since the 1990s the club has spent most of its time in the [[2. HNL|second division]], never gaining promotion to the [[Prva HNL|first league]]."}}
